topic: Sukuna sensed Yuji's Black Flash coming in chapter 256 and still got hit, because Larue stole his attention, not because Yuji got stronger
title: Sukuna Saw Yuji's Black Flash Coming And Still Lost
description: Sukuna felt Yuji's Black Flash coming in chapter 256 and still couldn't dodge it. Here's the one detail that explains how Yuji hit the King of Curses. Was it Yuji's skill or Larue's help?
comment: Did Yuji earn that Black Flash, or did Larue win that fight for him? Pick one.

lines.text: Sukuna saw Yuji's Black Flash coming, and he still couldn't dodge it.

shot.fallback: boy with pink hair punching with black lightning sparks

lines.text: A Black Flash needs cursed energy to land within a millionth of a second of impact.

shot.fallback: black lightning sparks around a fist

lines.text: Nanami said the first one puts you in the zone, where cursed energy feels like breathing.

shot.fallback: tall blond sorcerer in a suit

lines.text: Now watch Sukuna in chapter 256. He feels the punch coming and he braces for it.

shot.fallback: tattooed king of curses bracing for a hit
black lightning hitting a tattooed demon

lines.text: Because Larue used his technique, Cutie Honey, and dragged Sukuna's attention away for one second.

shot.fallback: old man sorcerer pulling attention of a demon

lines.text: That's the whole fight. Yuji didn't get stronger in that moment. Sukuna just looked away.

shot.fallback: pink haired boy surrounded by black sparks

lines.text: People call it luck. But Sukuna knew the hit was coming, which proves Yuji had earned it.
Then in chapter 257 Yuji chained several Black Flashes in a row, so the zone was real.

lines.text: The strongest curse in history lost the exchange to a distraction and a kid in the zone.
